sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Kell (need/must) is impersonal — the thing needed is the grammatical subject, not the object. You don't say 'kell + noun-t'; the noun stays in its plain form.
Kell még valami? and Desszert is kell both use the noun without -t, because kell doesn't take a direct object the way kérek does.
